title: Gone Fishing
summary: Jackie takes you fishing off a pier on the Arasaka Waterfront, where the catch is mostly junk and the gonk next to you bets he will do better.
description: Jackie brought a line and a bad attitude to the pier on the Arasaka Waterfront. He asked V to bring patience, because the catch is mostly junk.

start.bringUp: Jackie invites you to the pier on the Arasaka Waterfront. He brought a line and a bad attitude, and he asks you to bring patience.

pier.name: the pier on the Arasaka Waterfront

g1.asks: Tell me something good that's going to happen to you this year. Make it up if you have to.
g1.know: You are on the pier, it is quiet, and the catch so far is junk. A gonk is fishing on the next post.
g1.secret: Fishing makes him think of his mother.
g1.wants: V to talk about the future.

stages.label: Jackie and V fish off the Arasaka pier
stages.objective: Fish with Jackie off the pier on the Arasaka Waterfront
stages.know: You are fishing from the pier on the Arasaka Waterfront with Jackie. A gonk on the next post bets Jackie he will catch more. Dawn and dusk give better odds, and the catch is mostly junk.
stages.wants: V to stay on the pier for the full twenty minutes.

do.who: a street gonk who wants to share the spot and bets Jackie he'll catch more

stayed.memory: You stayed on the pier with Jackie on the Arasaka Waterfront for the whole twenty minutes, fishing for something worth keeping.

left.memory: You and Jackie fished off the Arasaka Waterfront, and you did not stay the full time.

unfinished.memory: You and Jackie were doing something light, and it ended there.

variations.know: Dawn on the pier, with better odds for a catch and a cold wind off the water.
Night on the pier with one lantern, and the water black beneath the rail.
A drizzle that only brings junk to the line, and Jackie laughing at every can.
